crossrefs.text: Therefore the Lord said: “These people draw near to Me with their mouths and honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me. Their worship of Me is but rules taught by men.
So now we call the arrogant blessed. Not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape.’”
They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.

I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, a dirge over the wilderness pasture, for they have been scorched so no one passes through, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. Both the birds of the air and the beasts have fled; they have gone away.
“Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You faithfully and with wholehearted devotion; I have done what is good in Your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
The tents of robbers are safe, and those who provoke God are secure— those who carry their god in their hands.
Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
If you faint in the day of distress, how small is your strength!
Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
When he speaks graciously, do not believe him, for seven abominations fill his heart.
“Let everyone guard against his neighbor; do not trust any brother, for every brother deals craftily, and every friend spreads slander.
When Josephʼs brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.
And his brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept in mind what he had said.
You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will consume it.
Come, all you beasts of the field; eat greedily, all you beasts of the forest.
You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil; you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.

You have planted much but harvested little. You eat but never have enough. You drink but never have your fill. You put on clothes but never get warm. You earn wages to put into a bag pierced through.”

then this is what I will do to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting disease, and fever that will destroy your sight and drain your life. You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

For You have abandoned Your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled with influences from the east; they are soothsayers like the Philistines; they strike hands with the children of foreigners.
So He poured out on them His furious anger and the fierceness of battle. It enveloped them in flames, but they did not understand; it consumed them, but they did not take it to heart.
Why spend money on that which is not bread, and your labor on that which does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me, and eat what is good, and your soul will delight in the richest of foods.
and if you can swear, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness, then the nations will be blessed by Him, and in Him they will glory.”
Yet afterward I will restore the Ammonites from captivity,” declares the LORD.
Yet in the latter days I will restore Moab from captivity,” declares the LORD. Here ends the judgment on Moab.
For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly destroyed.
In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north to the land that I gave to your fathers as an inheritance.
For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “After His Glory has sent Me against the nations that have plundered you—for whoever touches you touches the apple of His eye—
“Yet in the last days, I will restore Elam from captivity,” declares the LORD.
We will not return to our homes until every Israelite has taken possession of his inheritance.
